description:
Entry.content holds the entire HTML/text content of feed items (20-200KB per entry).

Impact: 100+ entries x 50KB = 5-10MB spike per feed. 50 concurrent feeds = 250-500MB peak allocation.

Root cause: Entry.record includes `content : String = ""` and EntryFactory.sanitize(content) creates additional String allocations.

Suggested fixes:
1. Add `strip_content : Bool = false` parameter to Entry.create and parsers
2. Add `include_content : Bool = true` config flag to RequestConfig
3. Use lazy content with Proc(String)

Status: Needs investigation and implementation.
title: Entry.content holds full HTML strings causing memory spikes
